# Light wordmarks

These assets are the official Light wordmarks, copied from the Light website:

- [Black wordmark](https://light.inc/assets/images/logo-light-black.svg)
- [White wordmark](https://light.inc/assets/images/logo-light-white.svg)

The landing page uses the white wordmark in dark mode and the black wordmark otherwise.
Keep these assets local so the README does not depend on the website serving its images.
